blocks.title: Research ethics
blocks.text: Research ethics are the principles researchers follow to keep their work honest, respectful and fair, protecting the integrity of research and the rights and well-being of participants, the research community and society.
If you survey classmates about how social media affects their study habits, ethics require asking permission before collecting personal information and keeping their answers confidential.

blocks.prompt: Name two ethical duties in a classmate survey.
blocks.explanation: Get their informed permission first, and keep their responses confidential.

items: Research ethics: honest, respectful, fair research that protects participants.
